_comment: Source of truth for GitHub labels on kandraos3/Telly. Sync with: python tool/tracker/tracker.py labels. Status lives on the project board, never in labels.

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Something is broken or behaves differently from its spec

labels.name: enhancement
labels.description: Improvement to something that already exists

labels.name: design
labels.description: Needs design work: layout, IA, visual tokens, mockups

labels.name: idea
labels.description: Raw idea, not committed to; may be shaped, parked or dropped

labels.name: epic
labels.description: Parent issue grouping sub-issues under one spec

labels.name: chore
labels.description: Process, tooling, CI, dependency or ops work

labels.name: human-only
labels.description: Needs the owner: consoles, secrets, stores, physical devices

labels.name: question
labels.description: Needs an answer or decision from the owner

labels.name: area:nav
labels.description: Bottom bar, More hub, routing and information architecture

labels.name: area:ranking
labels.description: Duels, binary insertion, TrueSkill, percentile scores

labels.name: area:profile
labels.description: Own and other users' profiles, canon lists, stats (SCR-14, SCR-15)

labels.name: area:queue
labels.description: Smart queue, custom and shared lists (SCR-13)

labels.name: area:backend
labels.description: Supabase schema, RPCs, edge functions, caching, push

labels.name: area:release
labels.description: CI, store submission, signing, monitoring, website

labels.name: area:process
labels.description: Tracking system, agent skills, repo conventions

labels.name: p0-blocker
labels.description: Crash, broken build, auth loop, data corruption

labels.name: p1-high
labels.description: Core flow broken, wrong ranking math, major visual regression

labels.name: p2-medium
labels.description: Secondary feature, UX clarity, layout polish
